name: Bhosa–Warora National Highway
significance: NH 361B is a branch of NH 361. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Bhosa to Warora, and it meets NH 361 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 361 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Hingna to Tuljapur
